sn8.5:2.1: catūhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatā vācā subhāsitā hoti no dubbhāsitā anavajjā ca ananuvajjā ca viññūnaṃ.
sn8.5:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu subhāsitaṃyeva bhāsati no dubbhāsitaṃ dhammaṃyeva bhāsati no adhammaṃ piyaṃyeva bhāsati no appiyaṃ saccaṃyeva bhāsati no alikaṃ.
sn8.5:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi aṅgehi samannāgatā vācā subhāsitā hoti no dubbhāsitā anavajjā ca ananuvajjā ca viññūnanti.
sn8.5:2.6: idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā
sn8.5:4.1: atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn8.5:4.2: paṭibhāti maṃ bhagavā paṭibhāti maṃ sugatāti.
sn8.5:4.4: atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sarūpāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi
